sections.thesis:
Why I own it: A model holding: a very large consumer hardware and services business, held as a core position for its cash generation.

What has to go right: Services keep growing as a share of sales and the installed base keeps upgrading.
sections.what_would_break_it:
• A daily close below the invalidation level (inv).
  • Two reporting periods in a row of falling services revenue.
